whole_take.source: issues_dump.jsonl: real data_issues of DiverseUMI takes labelled in parts, copied as written

issues.issue: The two explicitly side-named handheld camera streams appear assigned to opposite physical hands.
issues.evidence: At 0.00 s, left sees the other gripper on its left and right sees the other gripper on its right. At 62.06 s, exo shows the demonstrator's physical left gripper lifting the green shuttlecock while right moves with that gripper and shows the shuttlecock at its own jaws. At 214.21–215.22 s, exo shows the physical right gripper picking up the purple toy while left follows that pickup and shows the toy in its own jaws. Timeline arm values retain stream names as requested.

issues.issue: The recorded left_wrist and right_wrist side claims appear reversed: the left stream follows the gripper on the demonstrator's right, and the right stream follows the gripper on the demonstrator's left.
issues.evidence: At 423.36 s the left stream sees the opposite gripper to image-left and the right stream sees it to image-right. At 434.37-437.37 s the right stream moves with the exo image-left gripper reaching for the wrench while the left stream remains with the image-right gripper holding the toy. At 694.63-696.162 s the right stream again follows the image-left gripper withdrawing, while the left stream remains on the toy.

issues.issue: A stitch-grasp attempt ends with the right gripper withdrawing empty.
issues.evidence: left and right at 426.32–429.33 s show the unsuccessful pinch and empty withdrawal; 430.33–432.33 s show the successful retry.

issues.issue: The right gripper fails to retain the lace and must return for another pinch.
issues.evidence: left at 476.37 s shows the opposite gripper open and withdrawn from the stitch; left and right at 477.37–480.38 s show reacquisition and the loop beginning to lift.
